warning: SYNTHETIC PLACEHOLDER VALUES. These gauge totals are illustrative — they were authored to exercise the calibration framework, NOT derived from BOM/MHL feeds. Replace via scripts/build_gauge_observations.py before any operational use. Calibrated rainfall built on synthetic gauges is meaningless for engineering decisions.
source_note: Real implementation should pull station daily/hourly totals from BOM Climate Data Online, MHL/WISKI KiWIS, or equivalent. Stations should match the reference set used by data/catchment_ifd_centroid.json so spatial pairing remains stable.
methodology_note: Each station's totals_mm should reflect the gauge-observed accumulation over the same window endpoints used by data/catchment_rainfall_<key>.json. Pairings are recomputed in-browser at load time so the calibration adjusts as windows or radar inputs change. Calibration is multiplicative (radar * bias) and reversible (raw_total_mm always retained). NOT an AEP classification, NOT a return-period assignment, NOT a formal exceedance assertion.
